mentions.name: Custom Music Visualizer
mentions.description: A custom music visualizer application that gives the creator more control over the final rendered results than existing visualizer tools, built to produce visuals that complement the builder's electronic/ambient songs. A first proof-of-concept render was produced with it, and a second, more complex rendering-engine showcase was in the works.
mentions.problem: The builder was unhappy with existing visualizer tools and wanted something with more control over final results to better complement their music and achieve their creative vision.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a custom music visualizer application the past few weeks.
mentions.author: vectordust
